identity.name: Mira Lindqvist
identity.about:
Product engineer with eight years of building web tools that people use every day. I like small teams, short feedback loops and interfaces that explain themselves.

Lately I have been working on offline-first editors, design systems and making print output behave.

experience.title: Senior Product Engineer
experience.description:
- Lead engineer for a collaborative planning tool used by 1,200 teams; rebuilt the editor around a local-first sync model.
- Cut time-to-first-edit from 4.1 s to 0.9 s by splitting the bundle and caching documents in IndexedDB.
- Run the frontend guild: monthly reviews, a shared component library and an accessibility checklist.

experience.title: Frontend Engineer
experience.description:
- Built the dispatcher dashboard that replaced three legacy tools; adopted by every regional office within six months.
- Introduced visual regression tests and a design token pipeline shared by web and mobile.
- Mentored four junior developers through their first production releases.

experience.title: Web Developer
experience.description:
- Delivered 20+ marketing sites and microsites for cultural institutions, mostly static and hand-tuned for print.
- Wrote the studio's first accessibility guidelines.

projects.name: Paperweight
projects.description: A tiny library that paginates HTML into print-ready pages in the browser.

projects.name: Tram Times
projects.description: An offline-capable departures board for a fictional city transit network; 3,000 weekly users at its peak.

details: Thesis: Print as a first-class output for web applications.
